description: After confirming the user's goal, save a new recommendation iteration containing validated Claude draft proposals from their own skills/context. Optional priorities produce up to three proposals. A proposal never copies an agent or draft the user already has: when their skills are all in use the result is existing_agent_covers with those agents. Returns a background task; poll get_task_status. Monday synthesis is unavailable in this path. Never deploys.
name: recommend_new_agents
title: Recommend new agents
